description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Revised Expenditure Budget - 2025
reasoning: This gazette contains the publication of a revised expenditure budget for the Public Utilities Commission as required by the Public Utilities Commission Act No. 35 of 2002. The content focuses on regulatory compliance with statutory requirements (Section 33(2) and 33(3) of the Act) and presents budget allocations across utility sectors, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
